about_blocks.text: About Canadian Mental Health Association – Parry Sound Branch
about_blocks.html: About Canadian Mental Health Association – Parry Sound Branch

about_blocks.text: If you or someone you know is struggling with substance abuse, don’t hesitate to seek help. The Canadian Mental Health Association – Parry Sound Branch can provide the treatment and support that you need. Specializing in the treatment of substance, drug and alcohol abuse, this private rehabilitation facility offers a range of services to get you on the path to recovery. Some of these services include detoxification, individual and group counseling, family therapy, medication management (including addiction treatments like methadone or buprenorphine), nutrition counseling, exercise programs tailored to your specific needs, and more. Parry Sound Branch is located in Burks Falls in Ontario – a close distance from both Toronto and Ottawa metropolitan areas. If you are looking for quality mental health care that will help you recover from your addiction problem, then look no further than the CMHA – Pary Sound Branch!

about_blocks.text: Canadian Mental Health Association, Muskoka-Parry Sound Branch is committed to hope and recovery through integrated mental health and addiction services. Using effective, safe, innovative partnerships and practices, we provide the highest quality treatment, support, education and advocacy for the people of Muskoka-Parry Sound.
